start.welcome: 👋 Welcome, {name}! I'm your personal smart home assistant! 🏠 What I can do: 🍎 Kitchen - recognize products from photos └ Save to history, track expiry dates 🧾 Receipts - scan utility bills └ Extract amount, meter readings 💡 Smart Home - control devices └ MQTT, Home Assistant, on/off 📊 Statistics - analyze expenses └ Charts, categories, purchase history 👤 Profile - your balance and payments └ Crypto Bot, Telegram Stars ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ Select a section from the menu below 👇
start.help: 📖 📚 Command Reference Main commands: /start - Main menu /profile - Your profile and balance /devices - Device management /stats - Detailed statistics /pay [ID] - Confirm payment 🔐 Limits: • Free: 3 scans per week • Premium: unlimited + smart home 💳 Payment: • Crypto Bot (USDT) • Telegram Stars (1⭐ = 2₽) 📱 Links: • GitHub: [link in README] • Version: 1.0.0

menu.kitchen: 🍏 "Kitchen" Mode 📸 Send a photo of products and I will: • Recognize product names • Determine category (fruits, vegetables, dairy, meat, bakery, drinks) • Show approximate calories • Save to history • Check expiry date (if specified) Send one photo to scan
menu.receipts: 📄 "Receipts" Mode 📸 Send a photo of a bill and I will extract: • 💰 Payment amount • 📅 Period (month/year) • 🏠 Address • 📊 Meter readings • 📄 Service type (electricity, water, gas, heating) • 💵 Tariff and penalties (if any) • 🏷️ Account number Supports utility bills
menu.smart_home: 🏠 Smart Home Control smart devices: 💡 Light - turn on/off lighting 🔌 Sockets - power management 🌡️ Thermostats - temperature control 📷 Cameras - view status 🚪 Sensors - get data ⚠️ Premium required

smart_home.no_devices: 📭 No devices yet Add your first smart device: 1. Tap "Add device" 2. Enter name (e.g., "Living room lamp") 3. Select device type 4. Specify room 5. Enter MQTT topic or "ha" for Home Assistant 💡 Supported: • MQTT broker • Home Assistant • Light, sockets, thermostats
smart_home.add_name: 🔌 Adding Device 📝 Step 1 of 4 Enter device name: Examples: • "Bedroom lamp" • "Air conditioner" • "Smart socket" • "Temperature sensor"
smart_home.add_type: 🔧 Select device type 📝 Step 2 of 4 1. 💡 Light (light) - lighting control 2. 🔌 Socket (switch) - on/off 3. 🌡️ Thermostat (thermostat) - temperature 4. 📷 Camera (camera) 5. 🚪 Sensor (sensor) Enter number or type name:
smart_home.add_room: 🏠 Installation room 📝 Step 3 of 4 Enter room name: Popular rooms: • Kitchen 🧑‍🍳 • Bedroom 🛏️ • Living room 📺 • Bathroom 🚿 • Balcony 🌿 • Hallway 🚪
smart_home.add_topic: 📡 MQTT topic 📝 Step 4 of 4 Enter MQTT topic for control: Examples: • home/living_room/light • home/bedroom/socket • sensors/kitchen/temperature For Home Assistant enter "ha"
smart_home.premium_required: ⭐ Premium required! Smart Home is only available for Premium users. Premium benefits: ✅ ∞ product scans ✅ ∞ receipt scans ✅ 💡 Smart Home (MQTT + Home Assistant) ✅ 📊 Extended statistics ✅ 🔔 Payment reminders 💰 Price: from 99 Stars/month or 198 ₽/month 💳 Buy in profile
